newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to climb towards 4,885 then slip.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to climb towards 4,885 then slip.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index will resume its struggle to recover lost ground on Tuesday now that the panic attack from last week looks to be over, technical analysts said.
An impressive about-turn on Wall Street last night should help dispatch the FTSE towards 4,885 before slipping back a little, they added.
Short-term momentum indicators had exposed technical deficiencies of the market a few days ago and these still show the unreality of a swift move to record highs just yet.
By 0718 GMT, at the pre-market open, the FTSE was indicated up 29.7 at 4,864.7.

The market's flamboyant bull run has been crushed by last Friday's 125 point retreat and total market turnover will be light as investors turn more cautious, it only requires a crop of bargain hunters to lift the market because selling pressure has eased since Friday.

Buyers will scarcely need to exert themselves because Monday's rise by the Dow will be enough to make leading UK shares react positively but a lack of follow-through may make the FTSE shuffle down again later in the day.
On Monday, the Dow Jones industrial average marched up 108.70 points to 7,803.36.
